candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order:8000/v1/orders returns HTTP 500. Traces and logs show the order service failing with 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 to checkout clients.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within the order service (db, payment, inventory) is not established; only the order 500 propagation is observed.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s are consistently paired with order service 500s on POST /v1/orders in traces and logs; gateway durations are short, so this is an upstream error propagation, not gateway latency. The specific fault inside the order service is not yet evidenced.
missing_evidence: Order service traces/logs/metrics for POST /v1/orders to identify the internal 500 cause
Dependency metrics for order->postgresql, payment, inventory to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or downstream-latency
